policy.last_change: 4 Mar 2026 (-25bp, eff. 5 Mar); held 9 Apr and 6 May

policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 27 May close (1x4 3.90, 3x6 4.01, 6x9 4.33, 9x12 4.55 vs WIBOR 3M 3.86) price roughly 70bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 6 May (core probably rose in April; wait-and-see); Glapiński (7 May): the probability of a hike has risen and a cut is very unlikely - a CPI breach of 3.5% with persistent forecasts would trigger action. The April voting record (22 May) shows Tyrowicz's 100bp hike motion rejected with all others against; Glapiński (18 May): no commitments. April CPI 3.2% (final, 15 May; flash 30 Apr, 3.0% expected); core 3.0% (18 May). May flash CPI is due 29 May (Erste ~3.7%). The fuel VAT and excise cuts were extended to 31 May (13 May).
policy.risk_text: Deal hopes pulled Brent below $100 and trimmed hike pricing; the risks are a collapse of the US-Iran memorandum (US strikes on 26 May) and May CPI (29 May, ~3.7% expected) above 3.5%; long end: June supply and the deficit.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%; EC (21 May): GDP 3.5% in 2026. The July projection is the next marker.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.3% of GDP (GUS EDP, 22 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after April PLN 89.3bn (30.1% of the limit); the fiscal notification and the government's assumptions put the 2026 deficit at ~6.8% of GDP; EC (21 May): 6.5%, debt 64.5%; the SAFE loan was signed on 8 May; windfall-tax bill due in Q2 (75% of margins above the 2025 level +20%); fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps) extended to 31 May (13 May).
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~54% (MoF, 25 May) financed; budget accounts ~PLN 184bn at end-April (MoF estimate); 8 May T-bill PLN 3.66bn at 4.151%; CHF 885m priced on 21 May (first CHF deal since 2015). S&P affirmed A-/stable (8 May) and its analyst calls the missing medium-term consolidation the key rating risk (26 May); Scope A negative (15 May); Fitch and Moody's negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May; April CPI 3.2% y/y; Q1 GDP 3.4% y/y (flash). Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable (affirmed 8 May). 27 May: MoF sold PLN 10.1bn (offer 7-11bn, demand 12.7bn, cover 1.25) plus 0.14bn - PS0731 4.1bn at 5.29%, DS0436 3.1bn at 5.74%, DS1033 1.6bn at 5.45%; GPW Benchmark 29 May change: DS0436 joins TBSP (19 bonds), PS0527 leaves the 1-3Y and 1-4Y indices, NZ0331/NZ0928 join BWZ; the EC to pay a EUR 7.2bn KPO tranche; POLGBs little changed. Abroad: Brent fell 4.6% to $95 on hopes for a 60-day memorandum; Bund ~2.97% (near a 7-week low), UST 10Y 4.47%; the ECB deposit rate is seen at ~2.6% by December (~80% for June); BoE ~40bp by year-end.

calendar.plan_text: MoF May plan (30 Apr): sale auctions on 13 May (PLN 6-12bn), 21 May (7-13bn) and 27 May (6-12bn) in OK0129 (new 2Y, replaces OK0128), NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436 and NZ0936; a 46-week T-bill on 8 May (3-6bn); no switch. ~49% of 2026 needs financed after the April sales. 8 May T-bill: PLN 3.66bn at 4.151% plus 0.55bn. 13 May sale: PLN 11.01bn vs 13.73bn demand (cover 1.25) plus 0.85bn; OK0129 4.868%, PS0731 5.360%, DS0436 5.854%, PS0130 5.018%. 21 May sale: PLN 10.00bn vs 13.28bn demand (cover 1.33) plus 0.04bn; OK0129 4.887%, PS0731 5.433%, DS0436 5.883%, DS1034 5.718%. CHF 885m priced (3Y/7Y/10Y green). 27 May offer (25 May): PLN 7-11bn (DS1033 added). 27 May sale: PLN 10.12bn vs 12.66bn demand (cover 1.25) plus 0.14bn; OK0129 4.757%, PS0731 5.287%, DS0436 5.735%, DS1033 5.449%. BGK FPC (14 May): PLN 0.84bn on 1.10bn demand plus 0.15bn.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it and April's auction days cheapened on average. May supply is done (PLN 31.1bn sold plus 1.03bn additional); the June plan is due 29 May. Next MPC 1-2 Jun: a hold is expected; the July projection is the next marker. Covers: 1.25 (13 May), 1.33 (21 May), 1.25 (27 May) vs 1.13-1.25 in April.

facts.core_text: Regime: a 60-day US-Iran memorandum within reach - Brent below $100, Bund back under 3%; the NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May while FRAs price roughly 70bp of NBP hikes; the ECB is priced for a June hike, the BoE for hikes, the Fed has turned to hike risk under Warsh, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 51bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 281bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 27 May close). Brent $95 on memorandum hopes (27 May).

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK plans FPC switch tenders from June and a POLSTR floater in Q3 (25 May); FPC tender on 28 May.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
